# Orchard

A deliberately small GitOps repository, used as an integration fixture for `docsgen`.

The cluster definition lives in [fleet/prod-west](fleet/prod-west), platform components in
[platform](platform), application workloads in [workloads](workloads), and prose in
[handbook](handbook).

This file carries no frontmatter on purpose: it is one of the three entries the
`docsgen frontmatter` migration worklist must name.
